theorems.name: Submission.dtc_bc_local_comparison
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (Us As : ℕ → Set (Euclid P)) (Ss : (j : ℕ) → GeometricCurrentOn (Us j) (m + 1)) (Ŝ : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)) (ρ : ℕ → ℝ), m + 1 < P → (∀ j, IsOpen (Us j)) → (∀ j, IsMinimizingIn (Ss j) (As j)) → (∀ j, (Ss j).support ⊆ As j) → (∀ R : ℝ, ∃ c : ℝ≥0∞, c ≠ ∞ ∧ ∀ᶠ j in atTop, (Ss j).massOn (ball 0 R) ≤ c) → (∀ G : ℝ, 0 < G → ∃ πs : ℕ → Euclid P → Euclid P, (∀ᶠ j in atTop, ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (πs j) (ball 0 G) ∧ MapsTo (πs j) (ball 0 G) (As j) ∧ (∀ y ∈ As j ∩ ball 0 G, πs j y = y) ∧ ∀ y ∈ ball 0 G, ‖πs j y‖ ≤ 2 * ‖y‖) ∧ ∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η → ∀ᶠ j in atTop, ∀ y ∈ ball 0 G, ∀ z ∈ ball 0 G, ‖πs j y - πs j z‖ ≤ (1 + η) * ‖y - z‖) → IsIntegerMultiplicity C → (∀ j, IsIntegerMultiplicity (Ŝ j)) → (∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → Bornology.IsBounded W → ⨆ j, ((Ŝ j).massOn W + (Ŝ j).boundary.massOn W) < ∞) → WeaklyConvergesOn Ŝ C → Tendsto ρ atTop atTop → (∀ j, closedBall (0 : Euclid P) (ρ j) ⊆ Us j) → (∀ (j : ℕ) (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)), tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1)) ⊆ ball 0 (ρ j) → Ŝ j ω = currentEval (Ss j) (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1))) → ∀ (K : Set (Euclid P)) (ε : ℝ), IsCompact K → 0 < ε → ∀ ψ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono ψ → ∃ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W ∧ K ⊆ W ∧ W ⊆ thickening ε K ∧ ∃ φ' : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ' ∧ ∀ S : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1), IsIntegerMultiplicity S → SameBoundary S C → (S - C).support ⊆ K → limsup (fun j => (Ss (ψ (φ' j))).massOn W) atTop ≤ S.massOn W
